summary:
Incorrect IPv6 host parsing in RfcUriParser, the RFC 3986 parser UriComponentsBuilder
uses as of 6.2 (added by commit 52805da733, first released in 6.2.0; the advisory range is
6.2.0 - 6.2.18 and 7.0.0 - 7.0.7). 5.3.20 has no RfcUriParser: UriComponentsBuilder parses
with the URI_PATTERN/HTTP_URL_PATTERN regexes, hardened here by the CVE-2024-22243/22259/22262
patches. The fix ce90e4b11f only changes RfcUriParser.
